title: TN5250 protocol stack and wire boundary
summary: The TN5250 vertical slice composes Telnet negotiation, RFC1205-compatible record framing, 5250 workstation data-stream decoding/encoding, presentation-space/field semantics and higher-level automation. Wire bytes are not semantic authority and may contain secrets.
invariants: Binary, EOR and terminal-type negotiation belong to Telnet/TN5250, not the presentation model.
Raw READ/input response bytes are trusted-runtime data and must not be returned through safe automation surfaces.
5250 field semantics, AID behavior and operator conditions remain distinct from TCP/TLS transport lifecycle.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
